limits: The six-coordinate VDADDD and four-coordinate VVVG are literal source observations, not silently normalized five-letter groups.
The frame excludes one printed D and adds one unobserved coordinate; it is a conditional copying-error model, not an improved OCR reading.
Three repeated-D exclusions and four V-insertion positions give twelve ownership descriptions of the same V-completed ciphertext. The unfilled raw streams differ.
In the one-V parallel-supplied layer, the V comes from original p159 B under the inherited component correspondence; every retained p168 observation stays unchanged.
The new KDO evidence is an observed p168 coordinate, not a guessed letter or a new square assignment. Other garbled words and numeric labels are retained.
This is a new full-source certificate for an already catalogued retransmission, not a new physical message or first decipherment of order11338.

Separate two-witness and three-witness joint layers change five or six retained p168 observations respectively; each has an original printed donor. The sixth uses p158 D source7, because p159 B source7 is invalid R.
